record.body:
## Description

R15: The live store's `.canon/config.json` lists `composer` at `1.0.0`.

## Approach

From the primary checkout run `CANON_SCHEMA_PATH=<worktree>/orchestra/composer/schemas/composer.json canon schemas add composer`; the module is not installed from `main` until the merge. Then read `.canon/config.json` and confirm `composer` is `1.0.0`. Only the parent session writes the store.

payload.title: Add composer to the live store
